You can add an optional 2-day, 1-night trip to Paracas and the Nazca Lines. A tourist coach takes you from Lima to Paracas, where you spend the night at a hotel on the Pacific coast.

A flight over the Nazca Lines is available as an extra. From the air, you can see giant depictions of animals and birds and geometric figures etched into the desert floor. We calculate the price for this two-day trip separately and coordinate it with your arrival from La Paz.
The cathedral and neighbouring historic buildings lit up at night in Lima, Peru
Lima: illuminated cathedral towers and façades on the square at night

Breakfast. The rest of the day is free to explore Lima, visit museums and browse souvenir shops. You can try Peruvian cuisine at the city's cafés and restaurants.

Alternatively, you can take an optional full-day trip to the Ballestas Islands and the Nazca Lines.

The price is $550 net per person. The tourist coach leaves Lima for Paracas early in the morning. The boat tour to the Ballestas Islands starts at 08:00.

From the port of Paracas, the speedboat passes the Candelabra geoglyph on a sandy slope of the peninsula. Sea lions, pelicans, cormorants and other seabirds live around these rocky islands, sometimes called Peru's Little Galápagos. You can see coastal caves and rock arches from the water.

After the boat trip, you travel to Nazca and take a flight over the geoglyphs. The desert drawings include animals, birds, a human figure and geometric shapes. The scale of many of them only becomes clear from the air. Researchers continue to study their origins and purpose.

Lunch at a restaurant serving Peruvian cuisine is included. You return to Lima by coach in the afternoon and spend the night at the 4-star Ikonik or a similar hotel.
